text: Yeah, those exercises can be allowed. It's just that I don't want to make them primary exercises. None of these look like primary exercises for the program, so they can be optional, and they can be chosen and added, but not primary ones that the program is going to throw at you as part of the template. The only ones that I see that might be primary are wall balls and sled pushes because that's part of High Rocks programming. In the High Rocks program, that can be there, but not in any other program if not needed. Maybe in the CrossFit program, but that's it.
